title: Form of licenses.
bodyText: The form of every license shall be prescribed by the director, and shall be issued in the name of the department, and signed by the director.
bodyHtml: §441-30  Form of licenses.  The form of every license shall be prescribed by the director, and shall be issued in the name of the department, and signed by the director. [L 1967, c 199, pt of §1; HRS §441-30; am L 1975, c 21, §14; am L 1981, c 221, §16]
